highlights_headline: The next SkiaSharp release moves the native renderer to Skia m157 without changing managed API declarations.
highlights_body: The update retains the m156 glyph-bounds guard. HarfBuzzSharp moves to package revision 14.4.0.200 while its native HarfBuzz engine remains at 14.4.0.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled renderer to milestone 157, preserving the existing glyph-bounds guard and leaving managed wrappers and generated declarations unchanged.
